violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED: frozen tuna was thawing in intact reduced oxygen packaging (ROP) in walk-in cooler (sushi).
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated the CFM and sushi chef. EHS prompted sushi chef to make a cut in each of the ROP.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: - OBSERVED: ambient temperature of 4-door stacked cooler (grill 4) at 45F and 2-door upright cooler (G &G 1) at 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: TCS foods discarded or relocated. Work orders were placed.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED TUNA WAS THAWING IN INTACT REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGES (ROP) IN WALK-IN COOLER (BEVERAGE).
violations.corrective_action: CFM MADE A CUT IN EACH OF THE ROP.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: MISO RAMEN BASE (38F) WAS PORTIONED ON 3/18/2025. BY THE TIME OF INSPECTION, IT HAS BEEN STORED IN 1-DOOR COOLER (SUSHI 1) FOR MORE THAN 7 DAYS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. FOOD ITEM WAS DISCARDED.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: HACCP Plan Required by Law
violations.observation: A HACCP Plan was not submitted prior to engaging in @ @. PIC SHARED THAT THE ACCEPTABLE PH RANGE FOR SUSHI RICE IS 3.5 TO 4.3, AND SUSHI RICE WILL BE KEPT AT ROOM TEMPERATURE FOR UP TO TEN HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: (1) PH VALUE OF SUSHI RICE SHOULD BE 4.2 OR BELOW; (2) USING TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL PROCEDURE, SUSHI RICE CAN ONLY BE STORED AT ROOM TEMPERATURE FOR UP TO FOUR HOURS.

out_items.name: Variance obtained for specialized processing methods

violations.title: Variance Request, HACCP Plan
violations.observation: A HACCP plan is missing from the variance request.
violations.corrective_action: SHOULD THE FACILITY WANT TO KEEP SUSHI RICE AT PH ABOVE 4.2 FOR TEN HOURS AT ROOM TEMPERATURE USING TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL PROCEDURE, THE FACILITY SHOULD SUBMIT A HACCP PLAN FOR SUSHI RICE TO HEALTH DEPARTMENT FOR APPROVAL.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED AN UNAPPROVED SPLITTER INSTALLED ON THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. AN APPROVED SPLITTER HAS BEEN INSTALLED ON THE MOP SINK.
